title: I Call the Sabbath a Delight
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The week is full of running feet
And errands, loud and fast;
But one day comes with slower songs
And quiet hands at last.

[Chorus]
I call the Sabbath a delight,
A gift made just for me;
I turn my busy feet around
And find Him close to me.

[Verse 2]
I sit beside the window wide
And watch the sunlight play;
It slides so slowly on the floor,
There is no rush today.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
We gather close, my family,
We sing a gentle song;
The quiet is not empty, no,
It's full the whole day long.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
He lifts me up on sunny hills,
Like riding way up high;
I see the whole wide world below
Beneath a shining sky.

[Chorus]
mood: Slowing-down music. Soft felt piano begins with a small busy running figure, then lets it go into slow, wide chords with room between them, like a child stopping at a sunny window to watch the light cross the floor. An unhurried walking pulse from there on, and in the last verse the chords climb step by step, like being carried gently up onto a bright hilltop.
